title: Research markdown frontmatter
description: Every .md under research/ must open with a YAML frontmatter block conforming to this schema. Enforced by scripts/validate_research_tree.py.

record_kind.description: How this document relates to time, which decides whether its numbers may go stale. 'state' asserts what is true NOW and is guarded by validate_registry.py R5 against restating a superseded value as current. 'ledger' is an append-only historical record whose numbers are frozen by design (submissions, experiment rows). 'archive' is a dated snapshot kept for provenance. Absent means unclassified and outside the R5 guard.
